title: The Protocol of Kowloon
author: T. M. Kavanagh
blurb: Orsen Galloway, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, has spent five years following rules that keep getting rewritten. But when a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must burn the network that did the training before the summit convenes.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
